corruptSays.line: The stash count is off. 1 stone missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
The stash count is off. 1 stone missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
The stash count is off. 1 stone missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
Devon looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.

◈ FLASHBACK — Brass Locket
Brass. Two photos inside, both fading. It opens with a click you can feel in your teeth — Esther's click, then your mother's, now yours.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dispatcher's headset
You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts.

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

◈ FLASHBACK — Home key
The key never leaves your pocket. Locks are a promise: somewhere, a door still fits this.
Word reaches you, days late: Ivana stands accused over what happened to Aroha. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Aroha has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Ivana answers for what happened to Aroha.
Aroha calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.

Zoey leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Hushpuppy. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Wound the lead — Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.
💛 The Dispatcher's headset has become something you can reach for. (Keepsake L2 — new combat action: Steady. Hold it and breathe: clear fear and stun on yourself. Once per fight.)
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Theo.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
They're named, every one: Kira Costa, Fatima Okafor, Maya Haddad. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📓 Codex: 3 petitioners from Stonebridge (cannibal): Kira Costa, Fatima Okafor, Maya Haddad.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Kira nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
Devon showed Priya the huge smooth white ball sitting on the ground, sometimes head-sized — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Priya showed Aubrey the huge smooth white ball sitting on the ground, sometimes head-sized — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

Journal updated: colonies of umbrella-like leaves, single lemon-sized fruit hidden underneath grows here too — better than tall smooth stalks turning reddish-purple, with dark purple berry clusters in late summer.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.

Travel 3 tiles to meadow.
— Open ground —
The grass is bent in a long smooth run, like something heavy slid through it. You walk the other way around.
You notice the village gives you room on the path now. Not fear, exactly. Room.
🔍 Klaus has been turning over tall smooth stalks turning reddish-purple, with dark purple berry clusters in late summer for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
★ IDENTIFIED: Pokeweed. Smooth stalks, purple-red stems, dark berry clusters. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 Pokeweed. The tall smooth stalks turning reddish-purple, with dark purple berry clusters in late summer you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Emberhold bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
